Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Great question! A damaged or faulty item is handled as a complaint, not a normal return. In My Pages or via the claim link, select the item, choose “I want to create a complaint,” add a reason and short description, upload clear defect photos, and submit. Nelly usually replies within 1–2 days. If needed, you’ll receive a free return label; approved claims have no fee and can take 3–4 weeks.
Normal returns must be registered in My Pages within 14 days, sent back well-packaged, and usually cost €9.95 / £9.95 / 49 zł. Refunds can take up to 14 days after shipping. If you need more help, I can connect you with a human. 📦
